coverage_reconciliation.explanation: These totals describe different venue counts, contract universes, timestamps and normalization methods. They are not four estimates of one identical population.

overlapping_binance_contract_comparison.interpretation: The two explicit Binance XRPUSDT observations are close; Loris is also within approximately 2% but may aggregate a different Binance instrument set.

unresolved_bybit_comparison.interpretation: A material Bybit OI difference remains after comparing displayed exchange totals. Contract coverage, unit normalization, stale observations or aggregator mapping may explain it; none is proven.

coverage_reconciliation.source_independence: Aggregators reuse overlapping public exchange feeds. Their dashboards are not independent economic confirmations; venue-level raw contract records are the appropriate reconciliation unit.

observations: Kraken XRP/USD last is approximately 4.29% below its current UTC-day open and 3.45% below rolling 24-hour VWAP.
The latest Loris and Kraken spot references cluster near $1.248, while the Loris Bybit row at $1.3091 is a quarantined outlier pending synchronized contract validation.
Positive funding is reported across the covered Binance and Bybit contracts; positive funding means longs pay shorts, not that spot demand is necessarily bullish.
Account-based long percentages are elevated on Binance and Bybit, but account counts are not position notional or capital at risk.
Taker-buy shares are approximately 50.9% on Binance and 49.1% on Bybit in a partial two-venue sample; this is not strong evidence of a broad aggressive-buy imbalance.
Reported long liquidations exceed shorts in the two covered venues, but liquidation-history coverage is incomplete.
Aggregate open interest ranges from $737.35M to $2.22B because the source universes differ; Binance overlap is close while Bybit overlap remains unresolved.

competing_hypotheses.statement: Long-side deleveraging may have amplified the spot decline.
supporting: Long liquidations exceed short liquidations in the partial Binance/Bybit sample.
Funding remains positive, so long carry demand persists.
disconfirming: Account counts do not establish notional leverage or net exposure.
OI totals and Bybit exchange values remain unreconciled.

competing_hypotheses.statement: XRP weakness may reflect broad crypto/risk-asset repricing rather than XRP-specific selling.
supporting: The synchronized spot observations show a broad price decline within the captured window.
disconfirming: This artifact does not contain a synchronized BTC/ETH/equity/yield panel or event study.

competing_hypotheses.statement: A material portion of the apparent derivatives disagreement may be caused by venue/contract scope, unit normalization or stale venue rows.
supporting: Kodexius covers seven contracts across five venues; Loris covers forty venues; BitcoinLeverage covers only Binance and Bybit.
Binance contract observations are close across Kodexius and BitcoinLeverage.
Loris contains a Bybit price outlier and internal 24-hour change disagreement.
disconfirming: Bybit OI remains materially different across aggregators even at the exchange-total level.

competing_hypotheses.statement: XRP-specific spot supply or ETF redemption pressure may be contributing.
supporting: This remains a plausible alternative requiring issuer and exchange-flow data.
disconfirming: No synchronized exchange-wallet flow, issuer AP cash ledger or venue-level aggressive-seller series is included here.

admission.reason: Rendered snapshots have unsynchronized source timestamps, no byte-exact raw captures or independent timestamp anchors, overlapping aggregator feeds and unresolved Bybit OI scope. Research-only; not a model feature set or directional forecast.
